en: I came because of your note.
I'm glad you've recovered fast... And that you can read!
What happened?
You’ve been out cold for half a day. Shot in the back by a sniper, according to Yelena.
I took care of you all night... God, I was worried... But seems that’s just a regular day for a Vulture.
What are you doing here?
Someone had to give this poor soul a proper funeral. I was the only one available. Apologies for not staying at your bedside, Returner.
Funeral?
Oh, yes; a simple rite for the recently deceased. We commemorate their life, and send them unto God above.
This poor soldier, Ilich; so young. Shot clean through the head... Yelena somehow still had hope in her eyes when she dragged both of you here. Be sure to pay her a visit.
You in charge around here?
Not at all; I am but a humble Acolyte.
I have modest medical knowledge, so I mostly work in the Hospital – and help out with things like this when there's no one else.
Thank you for taking care of me.
Thank God’s love for driving us forward, friend; I am naught but His instrument.
Just... Please don't go looking for revenge just yet. Let thy body heal.
I want details on this "funeral".
So you're interested in the Church's rituals, after all!
Tell me about the Acolytes.
Of course. The workings of the Church are not clear to outsiders...
I have to go now, Alexei.
Is this Funeral already over?
Well, yes... It was a short one. Had no time to gather my texts.
We typically have a singer and a reader performing together. With only me here, not much point dragging it on.
Although... The Trisagion... Yes, I would like to at least recite the Thrice Holy Hymn. Would you be willing to listen?
Of course.
Really! I'm glad. Without further delay, then.
"Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, Have mercy on us. Glory be to the Father, the Son and the Holy Ghost.
Now and forever, and from all Ages to all Ages. Holy Immortal, have mercy upon us. Amen."
Thank you, Returner. I hope this has sparked some interest in our world, which looks to the Heavens more than to Earth, as best it can...
Sorry, I'd rather not.
Shame. I suppose we're all in a hurry.
Do you hold funerals for anyone who dies?
Afraid not. Those who die in the Hospital are more likely candidates; a matter of convenience. Some folk expressly wish not to receive this service when they pass. The unconverted.
And of course, it wouldn't be proper to do this for the Bandits who terrorize our flock...
Why is this ritual so important?

Because it is a ritual, Returner; a tradition passed down from generations, which draws us closer to God and His teachings. Vultures have rituals too, don't they? So do Mudlarks, in their own strange way. The only way to understand is to live through them.
Today you have had a glimpse of our customs; though my voice is a flawed medium, I hope it somehow conveyed a part of God's beauty.
Today you'll hurry off to the wastes without caring first for your spirit; I hope that habit changes someday, for we all need saving. From Mist, from Rapture... From each other.
I have other things to talk about.
I see...
I really have to go right now.
Who are the Acolytes?
We are God's instrument in spreading His word. Me and my colleagues serve the Church of St. Dmitri, and the one true and all-loving God, however we can.

We receive bedding and housing from the Church; for most of us, it serves as payment. We also make do with odd jobs when need be. Some of us are simply volunteers, as well; and make do with our primary trades.
What is the Church?

An institution older, much older, than the Mist or the War; older perhaps than the East and West, than the continent of Rhos, or the world. It has helped develop Mankind through God, and through God may it edify us.
The Church houses and feeds us, looks after our sick, and gives us the spiritual foods through our rituals and Mass. You should come visit, Returner.
Do folks around here really care about religion?
Ha! A fair question. Many don't. Most have their eyes on the ground, though high is the way to Eternity. It is too tempting to prioritize immediate pains over eternal salvation. We guide who we can.
Let's talk about something else.
I have to leave now.
How the hell... Did I survive a shot to the back?
Good armor, I suppose? Though Yelena said it was a very high caliber weapon. And your armor never made it back from the Dola...
Who rescued me?
Yelena and poor Ilich. She said they never found the shooter... Not a regular Bandit, to get a jump on both Vultures and Palatines...
You should go thank her. Probably drinking in Arcadia as usual – that's way West of here. Tell her I said hello.
The armor I had on, my equipment... Any idea who took it?
Palatines are not above stealing from those they protect... But I don't think that was the case here. It might just be lying right where you were shot...
But best stay away from there. The far reaches of the Dola will be too much for a weakened scavenger with no equipment. Remember the sanctity of forgiveness.
About something else...
Gotta go, now.
Yes, I have an important job for you. Hope you've been to see the arms dealer already, since you will need weapons...

You see, poor Ilich's corpse has already begun to draw in the Mist. I'm rushing his ceremony so he can be sent to Lake Pavlie post-haste. The Mudlarks up North need to be warned of this corpse and any others you've found – or produced – at the Dola.
Will you warn the Mudlarks for me?
Sure, I'll do it.
Thank you. If you have any questions about the route, feel free to ask. I've been to see the Mudlarks before... Though they were not too welcoming.
I have a few questions, first.
Of course; ask away.
I don't have questions. Gonna get going.
I'm afraid I can't do it right now.
Are you sure? I would really appreciate your help... This is important for Zalesye, Returner.
I have questions before I decide.
Ask away, friend.
Where do I find the Mudlarks?
They're Northwest of here; you could try a straight line or pass through Arcadia down West before heading up. Dazbog Hollow, their home, is somewhere along Lake Pavlie's shores.
Don't the Mudlarks usually show up in time?
Usually, yes. But I'm a bit more worried than usual... The Mist claws at my eyes and nostrils already – don't you feel it? Churning your insides. An insult to all that's sacred...
Why hire a Vulture?

Unfortunately, the area around Lake Pavlie is quite dangerous. Palatines don't patrol the region anymore; and the Mudlarks, somehow, are left unbothered by Mutants. Only a Vulture can make the trip safely.
Why do corpses attract Mist?
That, I do not know. Our teachings speak of a forty-day period after death, where the dead may rise...
Seems the Mist, in its unholiness, has corrupted God's teachings; in much less time, it mutates those corpses which then come back to hunt us.
How much time does that usually take?
Could be a week, could be a lot less. That's why I'm worried – the workings of the Mist are still a mystery.
The Mudlarks may be pagans, but their services are invaluable. I pray their souls remain human even as their bodies are corrupted...
Can you spare any provisions for the road?
Well, it is a long trip... I have no food or water, but I can spare a few bandages, at least.
My decision...
Let's change the subject.
Well, sure... What is it?
I've got to get going.
Will decide later.
Have you had a chance to summon the Mudlarks? The Mist is starting to gather around Ilich's corpse...
Not yet.
Please, Returner, see to it quickly! The Mist grows in thickness; we cannot have it near our patients... Not again...
I still have some questions.
Ask away, friend.
Thank you, Returner! I knew I could count on your help. As for your reward...
Hello, my friend. I need your help with something. I hope you've seen the arms dealer already – weapons will be necessary...
Hello, my friend. What ails you?
If it isn't the most resilient Vulture I know.
Blessings upon you.
I need a chat.
Got a few questions.
Let's talk, Alexei.
I'd like to trade with you.
Got anything worth trading?
Need supplies – let's trade.
Thank you for your interest in the Church. I hope you'll ask me more sometime.
Thank you for the interest.
You said you needed help?
You asked for help?
Need my help with something?
We have few resources, but no harm in looking.
Hope something catches your eye.
We try not to value money over things, but...
What do you need, my friend?
Come to me with physical or spiritual ailments and I'll help.
Take care, my friend.
Come back when you can, Returner.
See you later, friend.
Blessings.
I'll help you.
Oh, you're a godsend, Returner. Thank you and take care...
I'll think about it.
Right, right. Perhaps you need more time to recover, after all...
Got any other requests?
God could offer better pay.
Glad to repay you a little.
Got jobs for a Vulture?
Any requests I could help with?
Acolytes need help with anything?
Us Acolytes could always use more medical items – not just drugs, but tools. Would you help us find some?
This region is full of deposits left unturned. I’m sure there are lots of medical items around. Would you bring some to me?
This hospital has seen better days... Treatment is a struggled without proper supplies. Would you help us find some?
This is a great help, Returner! God is pleased with our work today, I'm sure.
Why, thank you, thank you! This will help immensely...
I'm sure this will help with our next patients... Hopefully it won't be you who needs it, my friend.
I don't have any other requests right now.
I'm afraid that's all the extra work I can give, Returner.
I have nothing else. Perhaps others could help?
